{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-sd-x","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"c6cf12b7df9ec82594537195a86a3c936124e0fe6144e39596732691c943df46","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-sd-class-std:lineage:10","source_registry_sha256":"a4e51960bfe4da242ea11046073ac8d3d0353ce120a5409a11c1f9ab4c4da57a","source_liveness_sha256":"1aea607665fc1312b9a6988c94545b32e414886d6d428b2b6d66e4261f9397f1"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Noncommercial permits and examinations","heading":"C2 — Knowledge continuation and confusables: Noncommercial permits and examinations","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Knowledge continuation and confusables: Noncommercial permits and examinations

FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A10
License-test applicants must cooperate with the examiner and follow the examiner’s instructions. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A10
An on-road test applicant must supply a safe vehicle for the test. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A10
Pets and passengers are not permitted in the vehicle during the on-road licensing test. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A10
The handbook recommends leaving children and pets away from the exam station and prohibits them in the testing area and during the drive test. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A10
A person may apply for a South Dakota operator license at any examination station in the state. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A10
Ordinary license renewal may occur up to 180 days before expiration, except when the applicant is turning 21 at renewal. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A10
A license expiring 30 days after its holder’s twenty-first birthday may be renewed on that birthday or during the next 30 days. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A10
An application for a South Dakota license requires surrender of all South Dakota and out-of-state licenses and identification cards at application time. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R09 | anchor: A10
Transferring a currently valid out-of-state license ordinarily requires no testing, but the handbook excludes a license with a hazardous-materials endorsement from that exemption. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R10 | anchor: A10
When an out-of-state license is transferred, the prior state is notified and its credentials become invalid. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R11 | anchor: A10
Examiners cannot issue a license to an applicant physically incapable of driving. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R12 | anchor: A10
An examiner may require testing when an applicant appears physically impaired. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R13 | anchor: A10
The licensing procedure includes taking the applicant’s photograph each time the applicant comes in. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R14 | anchor: A10
If glasses or contacts are used for the vision test, they must also be worn when driving. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R15 | anchor: A10
After failing the vision test, an applicant must provide an optometrist’s or ophthalmologist’s statement certifying safe-driving visual ability before proceeding with the examination. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R16 | anchor: A10
The required knowledge test covers road rules and safe driving practices. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R17 | anchor: A10
A person caught cheating must wait at least 2 weeks before retesting rather than retest the next day. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R18 | anchor: A10
The driving test uses normal driving tasks to let the applicant demonstrate safe vehicle operation, without requiring illegal actions. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R19 | anchor: A10
At publication, the handbook required advance scheduling for drive tests at every location. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R20 | anchor: A10
After failing any licensing test, an applicant cannot retest before the next working day and may choose to wait longer to study or practice. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec03-R21 | anchor: A10
Each paid test fee allows 3 testing opportunities within 6 months, and 3 failures during that period require another fee. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0010]
